name: LaunchDarkly AgentControl
description: Takes each run's model, instructions and tools from a LaunchDarkly AgentControl config, and records run metrics

toolPrefix.description: Prefix removed from Library tool keys to get OpenClaw tool ids. Default: openclaw_

failClosed.description: Block runs when LaunchDarkly can't be reached. Default: false (runs keep OpenClaw's own settings)

hideTools.description: Hide tools the variation doesn't allow from the model. Default: true. Calls are blocked either way

initTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the SDK to connect. Default: 10

decisionLog.description: Optional path of a JSONL file that records what each run was served and what was blocked
